summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S., a Turkish telecom company, announcing an amendment to an existing long-term loan agreement with China Development Bank. The second tranche of a RMB 2.46 billion credit package was reduced from RMB 1.23 billion to RMB 700 million, and the annual fixed interest rate was lowered from 4.98% to 4.30%. Maturity and repayment schedule remained unchanged. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender offer, or other special-situation event is involved.
